_comment: Editorial content for GATI. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached: the company's plant photographs are not licence-cleared.
description: Gatron (Industries) Limited belongs to the Gani and Tayub (G&T) Group and has operated since 1980, producing polyester filament yarn at its factory in Hub, Balochistan; the company describes itself as Pakistan's largest producer of polyester filament yarn. It added a PET line in 1988, PET preforms in 2004, recycled polyester yarn under the Ecoron brand in 2017 and knitted fabrics in 2022.
headOffice: 11th Floor, G&T Tower, #18 Beaumont Road, Civil Lines-10, Karachi 75530, Pakistan
sourceNote: Company website (gatron.com: about-us, governance, contact-us), read 2026-10-17.
